name: pumpfun-trader-kit
description: Your open pump.fun positions in a pane while Claude works, and a markdown trade journal that fills itself. Read-only, no keys, no trading

wallet.title: Wallet address
wallet.description: Your main pump.fun wallet address (public, read-only: nothing here can sign or send)

journalDir.title: Journal folder (optional)
journalDir.description: Where the markdown journal is written. Empty means ~/pumpfun-journal

heliusKey.title: Helius API key (optional)
heliusKey.description: Only for the rewards section of /journal. Stored in secure storage

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the open pane re-reads the positions. Below about 20 the public pump.fun API starts answering 429

minSeconds.title: Open pane after (seconds)
minSeconds.description: The pane opens by itself when a turn runs longer than this

minUsd.title: Dust floor (USD)
minUsd.description: Positions worth less than this are hidden
